say:1:1741117001:1.text: Magister Merlin, do you believe in destiny?
say:1:1741117001:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，您相信天命吗？
say:1:1741117001:1.male: Magister Merlin, do you believe in destiny?
say:1:1741117001:1.female: Magister Merlin, do you believe in destiny?

choice_prompt:2:1741117001.text: Magister Merlin, do you believe in destiny?
choice_prompt:2:1741117001.source_cn: 梅林阁下，您相信天命吗？
choice_prompt:2:1741117001.male: Magister Merlin, do you believe in destiny?
choice_prompt:2:1741117001.female: Magister Merlin, do you believe in destiny?

say:4:1741117003:1.text: The Lightbearers have always believed in destiny. To us, nothing proves that more than the story of Goddess Dura giving King Rolan the holy sword—and the right to rule with it.
say:4:1741117003:1.source_cn: 耀光是个崇尚天命的国度。耀光历史上最神圣的时刻，便是艾...
say:4:1741117003:1.male: The Lightbearers have always believed in destiny. To us, nothing proves that more than the story of Goddess Dura giving King Rolan the holy sword—and the right to rule with it.
say:4:1741117003:1.female: The Lightbearers have always believed in destiny. To us, nothing proves that more than the story of Goddess Dura giving King Rolan the holy sword—and the right to rule with it.

say:5:1741117004:1.text: Everyone talks about the goddess's blessing. Everyone calls Rolan the chosen one. But they forget he was saving people from Hypofiends long before Dura ever appeared.
say:5:1741117004:1.source_cn: 所有人都在歌颂神恩，歌颂罗兰大帝是天选之人。但他们忘了...
say:5:1741117004:1.male: Everyone talks about the goddess's blessing. Everyone calls Rolan the chosen one. But they forget he was saving people from Hypofiends long before Dura ever appeared.
say:5:1741117004:1.female: Everyone talks about the goddess's blessing. Everyone calls Rolan the chosen one. But they forget he was saving people from Hypofiends long before Dura ever appeared.

say:6:1741117005:1.text: If he hadn't already been brave and strong, would the goddess have chosen him at all?
say:6:1741117005:1.source_cn: 如果罗兰大帝没有那种勇气与力量，女神还会选择他吗？
say:6:1741117005:1.male: If he hadn't already been brave and strong, would the goddess have chosen him at all?
say:6:1741117005:1.female: If he hadn't already been brave and strong, would the goddess have chosen him at all?

say:7:1741117006:1.text: Sometimes I think destiny is just a pretty word people put on success after it's already happened.
say:7:1741117006:1.source_cn: 我常想，所谓的天命，或许只是强者为自己的成功披上的一层...
say:7:1741117006:1.male: Sometimes I think destiny is just a pretty word people put on success after it's already happened.
say:7:1741117006:1.female: Sometimes I think destiny is just a pretty word people put on success after it's already happened.

say:8:1741117007:1.text: In the end, I don't think victory comes from being chosen. It comes from what you decide to do, and what you're willing to do to make it happen.
say:8:1741117007:1.source_cn: 真正决定胜负的，从来都不是神的旨意，而是人自己的意志和手段。
say:8:1741117007:1.male: In the end, I don't think victory comes from being chosen. It comes from what you decide to do, and what you're willing to do to make it happen.
say:8:1741117007:1.female: In the end, I don't think victory comes from being chosen. It comes from what you decide to do, and what you're willing to do to make it happen.

say:10:1741117008:1.text: That is... difficult to argue with.
say:10:1741117008:1.source_cn: 您的观点总是让人无法辩驳。
say:10:1741117008:1.male: That is... difficult to argue with.
say:10:1741117008:1.female: That is... difficult to argue with.

say:11:1741117009:1.text: But let me ask you this—back in the second Divine War, when you saved all those lives... was that destiny, or your own choice?
say:11:1741117009:1.source_cn: 就以您为例吧，您曾经在第二次神魔大战中拯救了无数世人，...
say:11:1741117009:1.male: But let me ask you this—back in the second Divine War, when you saved all those lives... was that destiny, or your own choice?
say:11:1741117009:1.female: But let me ask you this—back in the second Divine War, when you saved all those lives... was that destiny, or your own choice?

choice_prompt:12:1741117009.text: But let me ask you this—back in the second Divine War, when you saved all those lives... was that destiny, or your own choice?
choice_prompt:12:1741117009.source_cn: 就以您为例吧，您曾经在第二次神魔大战中拯救了无数世人，当时的您，凭借的是天命还是自己的意志呢？

choice_prompt:12:1741117009.female: But let me ask you this—back in the second Divine War, when you saved all those lives... was that destiny, or your own choice?

say:13:1741117010:1.text: Then I suppose I'll have to find the answer myself.
say:13:1741117010:1.source_cn: 如此……这个问题的答案，只能由我自己去找了。
say:13:1741117010:1.male: Then I suppose I'll have to find the answer myself.
say:13:1741117010:1.female: Then I suppose I'll have to find the answer myself.

choice:9:0:1.text: Trusting yourself too much can blind you too.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 过分相信自己，也可能是另一种盲目
choice:9:0:1.male: Trusting yourself too much can blind you too.
choice:9:0:1.female: Trusting yourself too much can blind you too.

choice:9:1:2.text: Some things are beyond our control.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 总有些东西，是我们无法强求的
choice:9:1:2.male: Some things are beyond our control.
choice:9:1:2.female: Some things are beyond our control.

choice:2:1:2.text: I believe more in the choices people make.
choice:2:1:2.male: I believe more in the choices people make.
choice:2:1:2.female: I believe more in the choices people make.
